title: Degree and quotient-double-coset criterion for bi-anchored thin chains in standard complex table algebras
author: Blau, Harvey I.
work: On residually thin and nilpotent table algebras, fusion rings, and association schemes
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 5 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/alco.194; exact archived official publisher native/PDF
difficulty_reason: The target recovers every thin quotient in a nested standard-table-algebra chain from a degree formula, through a new double-coset degree-constancy criterion and recursive quotient-chain reconstruction. Even after the named quotient and homomorphism prerequisites, the bidirectional induction and exact multiplicative transfer remain substantive proof obligations beyond routine qualification-exam arguments. No later integrality or nilpotence result contributes to this rating.
